managers.name: Same Season Diff Team
managers.description: Being realistic, you've been known to draft a good team. Unfortunately, we just don’t get to see you in the playoffs. It's like you curse the players you draft lol. Your RBs are reliant on a QB with a bad back and another QB that was a goober in his rookie season. I can see you dropping and replacing half of your bench by Week 6.

managers.name: Dicker Downs
managers.description: Ol Swep — we got a phrase coined after you. Still funny. I like your upside drafts on your bench — must have been doing some homework. QB: shaky. I thought it was a decent draft, but I guess we disagree since you already dropped stroud. lol

managers.name: R Odunze Day
managers.description: Great draft — I see you've been doing your homework. You're going to have to make some bye week maneuvers, but hey, worry about that when the time comes.

managers.name: Tig Ol Griddys
managers.description: If Cam Skattebo turned into something, this would be a great draft. I think you'll do fine initially and burn out toward the end of the season.

managers.name: We Get Big Ol TDs
managers.description: Hopefully, another year removed from the injury, Mr. Call of Duty himself gets more yards on the ground. This team is middling at best. You have no bench. I expect better from you. Also tell your qb to throw to marv. thanks.

managers.name: Alabama Assault
managers.description: Big troll with the Lamar and Allen grab. Great draft. Should be in good shape as long as your team gets a couple wins before your 'true' team returns from being suspended/hurt. The Mixon draft was just unnecessary. Those are some B-team WRs at the moment.

managers.name: SF 49ers Played Me
managers.description: I got the innanet going nuts. I have to institute new draft rules because of you. To draft McCaffrey two years in a row is nasty work. Your team is a glass cannon and I don’t like how you got the 49ers stack. I bet your team would've been really good with Rashee Rice lol.

managers.name: Bobz Cartel
managers.description: Guess who's back, Bobz is back. You are a bum for winning the chip and leaving. That type of energy is reflected in your draft. Your top WRs have questionable offensive situations. As a fellow Bears fan — not mad at the homer picks.

managers.name: Caleb and The Revolution
managers.description: Ah Pughdel, the original. I really like the upside you have on your bench — the in case of emergency break glass. This is a quality team, especially if Tyreek gets traded. I really can't hate, but I want to. Oh, you drafted some Packers. Shameful.

managers.name: Stafford Infection
managers.description: I hope your QB does well lol. Decent draft. Balanced. Real reliant on an unproven QB. Got a WR that’s ramping up and ah what do you have here, somehow, some way, you can't just quit Stafford — you got his #1 WR target.

managers.name: Stew's Super Quokkas
managers.description: Homer pick, Stew. Got some old RBs. Dakatoaaaa. How you feel about the loss of Parsons lol. I like Tet being your flex.

managers.name: Commishin aint Easy
managers.description: Things went off the rails once Drake fell to me at the second pick. A couple of teams have this build of star WRs and some maybe RBs. Here's to James Cook taking me back to the promised land. My favorite thing about this team is Team 'SF 49ers Played Me' not having Rashee Rice.
